SHG Gazette

The St Helena Government Gazette is published monthly and contains information on SHG appointments and staff changes, appointment of committee Members and Board members, change of name, etc. The St Helena Government Gazette Extraordinary is published on an ad hoc basis and includes enactment of legislation and legal notices.
